newsitem.title: USA: Kingston Technology cuts memory prices.
newsitem.headline: Kingston Technology cuts memory prices.

text.p: Kingston Technology Co on Tuesday said it cut prices up to 50 percent on its entire line of memory products, effective immediately.
In a statement, the company attributed the reduction to the further decline in dynamic random access memory (DRAM) component prices used by Kingston to manufacture its memory modules.
"With this reduction, customers will be able to purchase memory for under $15 per megabyte," the company said.
The company said the move will not force it to revise its projected 1996 sales of $1.6 billion.
